scene: The gardener clicks to life and signals three awaiting city transports.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left, a winged yellow scooter idles above the grass. Next stands the grandmother in pink tracksuit holding her white dog's lead. In the centre floats a red double-decker hover bus with open doors. The brass gardener gestures proudly toward a sleek gondola drone waiting on the far right.
shown: A sleek winged yellow scooter idling empty on the far left grass
A red double-decker hover bus floating with doors open in the centre
A gleaming passenger gondola drone hovering patiently on the far right
